d:
UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham celebrates Diwali at 10 Downing Street in London with the Indian diaspora, lighting diyas alongside his wife, Marie-France van Heel. The celebrations highlight the festival of lights, Indian culture and traditions, and the Indian community in the United Kingdom.
Also on Vantage shots:
• Giant skeleton sculptures fill Mexico's marigold fields ahead of the 'Day of the Dead'.
• Russia test-fires a Bulava ICBM from a nuclear submarine
